The '''Hall of Judgment''' was a chamber within the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Constructed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], it was a part of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] Base complex.
